# Externals

Interfaces for external data sources.

---

## Components

| **Component** | **Description** |
| ------------- | --------------- |
| **clients** | API client implementations for communicating with external data providers |
| **definitions** | source definition mapping raw provider identifiers to canonical dataset indicators |
| **providers** | interfaces for retrieving external data |
